🏁 GROW A PET RACER 🏁

💰 YOUR PETS EARN MONEY OFFLINE 😴

How to Play:
🥚 Hatch eggs and reveal insane pets!
🏃 Train your pets on treadmills to make them faster!
🏁 Race and win better eggs!
🔥 Fuse your pets into one unstoppable racer!
🧬 Collect rare pets, sizes and mutations!

🐉 Hatch a DIVINE pet and climb the leaderboards!

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
